title: A verbatim tag that is only a bang
notes: Production 98 matches `!<!>`, but a verbatim tag is delivered as is, and section 6.9.1 requires it to be a local tag (`!` followed by a name) or a global URI; example 6.25 lists `- !<!> foo` as invalid. The prefix `- !<!` can still become valid (`- !<!x>`), and `>` cannot be part of the tag, so the first character that cannot belong to any valid document is the `>` at column 6.

provenance.reference: A reader that accepted `!<!>` as a tag.
